name: Auto Finance autoUSD
oneLiner: autoUSD is Auto Finance's yield-bearing USDC autopool token on Ethereum, rebalancing across DeFi destinations while Royco Dawn lists tranche markets.
collateral: USDC deposited into Auto Finance's autoUSD autopool, with protocol-managed allocation across DeFi liquidity and yield destinations
pegMechanism: Autopool receipt-token share price appreciates as earnings auto-compound; withdrawals redeem shares for USDC subject to autopool liquidity and destination unwinds

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Ruling D18 requires the scored mechanism to follow the holder's actual claim. autoUSD is the identified ERC-4626 Autopool share whose USDC withdrawals depend on destination valuations, unwinds, fees and slippage. The reviewed architecture establishes a strategy-vault claim, not a direct fiat redemption obligation. No replacement archetype or classification override is asserted; the existing strategy-vault relationship remains, pending a reviewed score-family mapping for this exact product.
